scope_zh: 逐文件清单、大小及SHA-256复核，覆盖原始数据、代码、既有交付及可移植入口。排除根.git及本轮两个新目录；随后仅写新包清单和ZIP，不再修改源材料。
scope_en: File inventories, sizes and SHA-256 cover original data/code, prior deliveries and the portable entry. Excludes root .git and this task's two new directories; subsequent operations only write the new package manifest/ZIP, not source materials.
